root_cause: The export reads a denormalized total that the on-screen fix never updates.

design_decisions.title: Export totals still wrong: the fix needs a migration
design_decisions.decision: The export reads a denormalized column only a migration can correct; R6 forbids the loop to write one.
design_decisions.reviewer_must_confirm: Ticket the migration and merge this, or hold the PR until it lands?

noticed_not_changed: set_project_permissions never checks can_edit (pre-existing, intra-workspace) — needs its own ticket

alternatives.why_not: three copies to keep in step
